User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

planTierId.description: Reference to the PlanTier. (Relationship: PlanTier 1:N User)

PlanTier.title: PlanTier
PlanTier.description: Represents a plan tier with specific features and limitations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the plan tier.

name.description: The name of the plan tier (e.g., Basic, Premium).

maxVisions.description: The maximum number of visions allowed for this plan tier.

aiFeaturesEnabled.description: Indicates whether AI features are enabled for this plan tier.

price.description: The monthly price of the plan.

features.description: A list of features included in the plan.

Vision.title: Vision
Vision.description: Represents a user's vision, including different time horizons.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this vision.

title.description: A user-defined title for the vision.

goal.description: The user's primary goal or vision.

category.description: The category of the vision (e.g., Career, Health).

isPublic.description: Whether the vision is publicly shareable.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the vision was created.

Roadmap.title: Roadmap
Roadmap.description: Represents the AI-generated roadmap for a specific vision.

id.description: Unique identifier for the roadmap, same as the vision ID.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile data. Secured by path-based ownership, where only the user with the matching userId can access their own document.

/plan_tiers/{planTierId}.description: Stores plan tier information. This data is publicly readable by all users but is not writable from the client-side to protect its integrity.

/users/{userId}/visions/{visionId}.description: Stores the visions created by a user as a subcollection. Access is restricted to the owner unless the vision is explicitly marked as public.

/users/{userId}/roadmaps/{roadmapId}.description: Stores the AI-generated roadmaps for a user's vision. Access is restricted to the owner, or public if the corresponding vision is public.
